tools.description: The front door to Zaxy memory: call this first, before substantial work, to checkout current, cited, prompt-ready memory state for a session. Start here; every other memory tool is plumbing or power use, discoverable through memory_capabilities.

max_tokens.description: Optional prompt token budget; sections are greedily packed and elisions are reported in diagnostics.

purpose.description: Purpose profile name or object used to condition checkout guidance.

ref.description: Memory ref to checkout, e.g. HEAD or refs/heads/main

tools.name: memory_checkout

tools.description: Append a typed event to the agent's persistent memory log. Appended state becomes retrievable through memory_checkout, the front door for reading memory back.

tools.description: Query the temporal knowledge graph for relevant context. Power use behind the memory_checkout front door: reach for it when you need targeted hits, temporal filters, or pagination rather than a prompt-ready packet.

tools.name: memory_query

tools.description: Assemble replay plus ranked retrieval into a prompt-ready context bundle. memory_checkout, the front door, wraps this assembly with current facts, citations, and a trust contract.

max_tokens.description: Optional prompt token budget; sections are greedily packed and elisions are reported in the budget payload.

tools.name: context_assemble

tools.description: After using retrieved context, record whether a memory item was useful, stale, corrected, or reinforced. This closes the loop on context surfaced by memory_checkout, the front door.

importance.description: Optional 0..1 reinforcement importance for positive feedback

outcome.description: Optional action outcome, e.g. supported_handoff or avoided_failed_path

purpose.description: Optional purpose profile or preset that made this memory useful

tools.name: memory_feedback

tools.description: Mark a fact as invalid at a given time (bi-temporal update). History is preserved; the correction surfaces in later memory_checkout (front door) results.
tools.name: memory_invalidate

tools.description: Discover Zaxy's memory surface: active capabilities, the ambient usage loop, the active tool profile, and which tools remain callable beyond the listed set. memory_checkout is the front door; call this at session start or whenever tool awareness is unclear.

tools.name: memory_capabilities

tools.description: Experimental metamemory pre-check: predict whether memory_checkout would likely return something for a query, in roughly a millisecond, from in-memory session state only (no embedding call, no graph query). Returns a non-authoritative verdict (likely | possible | unlikely) with its signal breakdown and raw score. It is a cheap prediction about checkout, never a memory answer or evidence, and its calibration against real checkout outcomes is still being measured — when in doubt, call memory_checkout.

cues.description: Optional encoding-specificity cue fields (e.g. mission, workspace, tool, phase); cue values are probed against session memory alongside the query terms.

tools.description: Export a session's memory as a portable, cited bundle any product can consume. Pull-style: the caller selects what to export via the selector; entries carry sealed Eventloom citations. Returns a signed bundle when the server has an export signing key configured and sign=true, otherwise an unsigned canonical bundle.

admin_token.description: Admin token when admin gating is configured

disclose.description: Return a verifiable partial disclosure: sign the full bundle over the main selector, then reveal only entries matching this sub-selector (with Merkle inclusion proofs). Requires the server export key.

exclude_sensitivities.description: Redaction policy: drop entries whose event sensitivity tier is listed

kinds.description: Restrict to these event types (gates both grains)

query.description: Lexical pre-filter via the verbatim index
